reviews.t: Absolutely the best tanning product ever
reviews.x: Absolutely the best tanning product ever!  We have used various spray's, lotions & gel's over the years & this is by far the most natural looking.  The application goes on even and smooth & doesn't take a lot of product.  Do make sure you rub in until it is all absorbed into the skin to avoid any streaking.  Prior to aplication, I put a dab of lotion on my feet & knees so they don't look overly "tanned" - Would reccomend the use of gloves, though not necessary.  Great product.
